in_sanskrit.name: शर्वथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्वत् (sharvat) is derived from the Sanskrit word शर्व (sharva) which means 'God Shiva'. वथ (vath) is a suffix that means 'abode'. Thus, शर्वथ (sharvath) means 'God Shiva's abode'.

in_hindi.name: शर्वथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: शर्वथ (sharvath) is a Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word शर्व (sharva) which means 'God Shiva'. वथ (vath) is a suffix that means 'abode'. Thus, शर्वथ (sharvath) means 'God Shiva's abode'.

in_tamil.name: ஷர்வத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஷர்வத் (sharvath) is a Tamil name derived from the Sanskrit word ஷிவம் (shiva-m) which means 'God Shiva'. அத் (ath) is a suffix that means 'abode'. Thus, ஷர்வத் (sharvath) means 'God Shiva's abode'.

in_telugu.name: శర్వద్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శర్వద్ (sharvadh) is a Telugu name derived from the Sanskrit word శివము (shivamu) which means 'God Shiva'. ద్ (dh) is a suffix that means 'abode'. Thus, శర్వద్ (sharvadh) means 'God Shiva's abode'.

in_marathi.name: Sharvath

in_bengali.name: Sharvath
